# iaas_volume_protection_policy (Resource)

Schedules standalone volume backups and snapshots. Wall-clock schedules follow DST in the named timezone or the account owner's effective timezone. Manage membership with iaas_volume_protection_policy_attachment. Policies pause after consecutive failures; resume with the API or MCP reset_failures action. Deleting a policy detaches volumes and keeps its existing artifacts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iaas_volume_protection_policy" "nightly" {
  name             = "Nightly volume protection"
  frequency        = "daily"
  schedule_time    = "02:30"
  timezone         = "Europe/Amsterdam"
  backup_enabled   = true
  snapshot_enabled = true
  retention_mode   = "gfs"
  keep_last        = 2
  keep_daily       = 7
  keep_weekly      = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `frequency` (String) daily or weekly.
- `name` (String) Policy name, up to 255 characters.
- `schedule_time` (String) HH:MM wall-clock time in the effective timezone. Never converted to UTC by the provider.

### Optional

- `backup_enabled` (Boolean) Enable off-host backups. At least backups or snapshots must be enabled.
- `keep_daily` (Number) GFS daily buckets, 0..365. Zero or null disables this rule. At least one GFS rule must be positive.
- `keep_last` (Number) GFS newest artifacts, 0..365. Zero or null disables this rule. At least one GFS rule must be positive.
- `keep_monthly` (Number) GFS calendar month buckets, 0..120. Zero or null disables this rule. At least one GFS rule must be positive.
- `keep_weekly` (Number) GFS ISO week buckets, 0..520. Zero or null disables this rule. At least one GFS rule must be positive.
- `keep_within_days` (Number) GFS days of all artifacts, 0..3650. Zero or null disables this rule. At least one GFS rule must be positive.
- `keep_yearly` (Number) GFS calendar year buckets, 0..30. Zero or null disables this rule. At least one GFS rule must be positive.
- `retention_count` (Number) 1..365, required for count retention on create. Null on update keeps the stored count, as required by the API.
- `retention_mode` (String) count keeps retention_count artifacts per kind per volume; gfs applies keep_* rules only to this policy's artifacts.
- `schedule_day` (Number) Weekly day: 0 Sunday through 6 Saturday. Required for weekly; omit for daily.
- `snapshot_enabled` (Boolean) Enable volume snapshots. Proxmox per-volume protection is unsupported.
- `timezone` (String) Named IANA timezone. Omit or null to follow the account owner's timezone. Removing a configured zone clears it on the API.

### Read-Only

- `effective_timezone` (String) Resolved schedule timezone, including the account owner fallback.
- `id` (String) Policy UUID. Import using this UUID.
- `status` (String) Server status: active or error (paused).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iaas_volume_protection_policy.nightly <policy-uuid>
```
